text.p: These are significant stories in the Nigerian press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Curfew imposed in eastern Nigerian city of Owerri after riots over ritual murders.
- State-owned National Insurance Corporation raises capital base to one billion naira.
- Federal government sets 2010 deadline to end gas flaring, oil minister Dan Etete says.
- Lagos state government to create 10,000 jobs through road rehabilitation programme, says its military administrator Colonel Mohammed Marwa.
- Nigerian businessmen to embark on trade mission to Ghana and Sierra Leone next week.
- World Bank resident economist hails Nigeria's economic policies, sees recovery.
